cause_quote: The new popup added `if (anchorBounds != geometry.anchor || admitted?.size != popupContentSize) owner.cancel(this)`, which closed the menu even when its measured size differed by just one pixel.
user_saw: On affected Android phones, tapping Chat actions made the menu flash and immediately close.
summary: The fix rounds each padding edge separately, tolerates one-pixel measurement differences, and recalculates placement when the measured size changes.
reasoning: I checked that the parent used Material3’s DropdownMenu for Chat actions and already had a test that opened it and selected Refresh chat. PR #140884 replaced that working menu with a fold-aware popup whose exact-size cancellation explains the reported dismissal when Compose measured the popup one pixel taller than expected.
